fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Open Green Space; Dense Vegetation; Walkway; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Dense Vegetation; Limited Rear Access; Fenced Sections
fr.recommendations:
• Trim vegetation along the driveway and property entrance to keep the access path clearly visible from the street.
• Cut back dense vegetation that narrows or overhangs any walkway used by responders to reach the main residence or detached structure.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions on the street.
• Post the address number on the detached structure if it is accessible from a separate entry point.
• Keep any gates in fenced sections unlocked or equipped with a combination lock, and share the code with your local fire and police departments.
• Clear a continuous path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between them without pushing through dense vegetation.
• Identify and mark the rear access point so responders arriving from a secondary direction can locate it quickly.
• Keep both parking areas clear of stored items so arriving emergency vehicles have room to stage without blocking each other.
• Thin dense vegetation near the detached structure so responders can approach and work around all sides of the building.

wildfire.conditions: Tree Cluster; Large Trees; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Open Green Space; Limited Vegetation Separation; Adequate Vegetation Separation; Scattered Shrubs; Multiple Access Routes; Vegetation Along Driveway
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from trees that hang directly over or touch the house.
• Thin the tree cluster nearest to the structure to create open space between individual trees.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the foundation or walls of the house.
• Separate shrubs from the base of large trees so vegetation near the structure is not connected.
• Cut back shrubs and low branches along the driveway to keep the travel lane clear.
• Trim tree branches overhanging the driveway to allow full vehicle clearance.
• Remove dead branches from large trees near the structure before they fall onto the roof or walls.
• Thin scattered trees on the side of the property where vegetation separation is limited.
• Clear dead leaves, needles, and plant debris from the roof and gutters.
• Keep the area directly around the structure free of piled yard debris, wood, or loose plant material.
